column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm” to the title “Of David.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV renders the statements as wishes, and “in vain” as “without cause.”
Close to the Hebrew; “compassions” is rendered “tender mercies,” and “acts of covenant loyalty” “lovingkindnesses.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty and faithfulness” is rendered “mercy and truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in good” is rendered “in prosperity,” and אָרֶץ “the earth.”
Close to the Hebrew; סוֹד (“the counsel, intimacy”) is rendered “The secret.”
Close to the Hebrew; יָחִיד (“alone”) is rendered “desolate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “hatred of violence” is rendered “cruel hatred.”
NKJV follows the Hebrew, without the Septuagint addition “O LORD.”
